academic_integrity.en: AI use lacking the policy’s responsible-use characteristics may constitute misconduct. AI detectors are currently not recommended because of validity and reliability concerns.
academic_integrity.zh: 不具备政策所列负责任使用特征的 AI 使用可能构成不端；因效度和可靠性问题，政策目前不建议使用 AI 检测器。
academic_integrity.meaningEn: “May” is conditional, and “not recommended” is not a universal ban. The policy has multiple misconduct levels; a conditional Level 1 resubmission cap is not a blanket AI penalty. Full SOP and appeal coverage remain gaps.
academic_integrity.meaningZh: “可能”须保留条件，“不建议”不能改为全面禁止。政策区分多个不端等级，一级重交的有条件分数上限不能改为统一 AI 处罚；完整程序及申诉规则仍有缺口。

teaching_guidance.en: Module staff must ensure signed declarations accompany written submissions; communicate the applicable course rules.
teaching_guidance.zh: 模块负责人须确保书面提交物附签字声明，并说明适用课程规则。
teaching_guidance.meaningEn: Declaration obligation is from 2025; communication guidance is retained 2023 context. This does not establish permission to automate grading.
teaching_guidance.meaningZh: 声明义务来自 2025 年政策，沟通指引保留为 2023 年背景；不能据此认定允许自动评分。

security_procurement.en: A current AI procurement and security approval workflow was not established.
security_procurement.zh: 尚未核实当前 AI 采购及安全审批流程。
security_procurement.meaningEn: The existence of an academic misconduct policy does not establish vendor or data-security approval.
security_procurement.meaningZh: 存在学术不端政策不等于已批准供应商或数据安全。

scope.en: Use the source-specific audience, assessment and publication limits below. Institution-wide policy review remains PARTIAL.
scope.zh: 请按下列来源的对象、考核及发表范围使用信息，整校政策审核仍为 PARTIAL。

do.en: Declare any and all use of generative AI.
do.zh: 声明所有生成式 AI 使用。

dont.en: Do not present AI-generated work as your own.
dont.zh: 不得将 AI 生成的作品当作本人作品。

claimDispositions.scope: Original public Claim retained in its source-specific scope; institution audit remains PARTIAL.
claimDispositions.reason: Retained original Claim; this does not establish unrestricted assessment permission.
